positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant and Technical Advisor
positions.description: Adding engineering and architectural expertise to lay the foundation of a tech enabled startup. Building cool things in React, Node, Serverless and Lambda.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description: Bringing software engineering expertise to early stage teams. Have worked on backend architecture, reporting, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, alerting, monitoring, etc... My goals are 1) to leave each company and team in a much stronger position than before we met, and 2) to make career-long connections. Don't hesitate to reach out!

positions.title: Software Engineer Lead
positions.description:
- Contributing to data collection, analysis, and integration with software platform
- Leading product direction in tandem with engineering recruiting effort

positions.title: Co-Founder and Co-CTO
positions.description: Led sales and business development at tech startup building a software to automate the financial due diligence process. The software integrates directly with a client's accounting software, allowing an analyst to pull any data they want (with the approval of the client of course). Designed for consultants, investment bankers, lenders, and more.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the Lync Server team in Office, focusing on improving server performance. Responsibilities included:

- Performance and capacity planning of Lync servers
- Development of automation tools to perform load tests
- Development of deployment automation tools
- .NET/Windows Debugging
